conditions.displayName: transit-pipeline execution finished FAILED or CANCELLED

conditionThreshold.filter: resource.type = "workflows.googleapis.com/Workflow" AND resource.labels.workflow_id = "transit-pipeline" AND metric.type = "workflows.googleapis.com/finished_execution_count" AND metric.labels.status != "SUCCEEDED"

documentation.content:
The weekly pipeline ended without success.

1. Check the database tier first; it should be `db-f1-micro`:
   `gcloud sql instances describe transit-db --project seoul-transit-prod --format="value(settings.tier,state)"`
2. Find the failed step:
   `gcloud workflows executions list transit-pipeline --location asia-northeast3 --project seoul-transit-prod --limit 1`
   `gcloud run jobs executions list --region asia-northeast3 --project seoul-transit-prod --limit 10 --sort-by="~metadata.creationTimestamp"`
3. After fixing, rerun with `--data '{"force":true}'`.
